result.topic_en: Computation of the volume of a pyramid ABCD with an infinitely small dihedral angle θ at edge AB, expressed in terms of AB = x, AC = r and the angle φ at A, presumably in non-Euclidean geometry.
result.transcription:
Noch zierlicher
[figure: right triangle with vertices A (top left), B (bottom left), C and D (right, close together); angle $\varphi$ at A; dotted line from A to D]
Inhalt der [-unend-] Pyramide ABCD
Unendlich kleiner diedrischer Winkel
an AB ...... $\theta$
$AB = x$
$AC = r$
Volumen $= \frac{1}{2}(x - r\cos\varphi).\theta$

methods.what: Volume of a pyramid (tetrahedron) ABCD with infinitesimal dihedral angle θ at edge AB, given AB = x, AC = r and angle φ at A
